title: Production Kubernetes & Extending the API
summary: What changes when you run Kubernetes for real: managed clusters and EKS specifics, upgrades and version skew, multi-tenancy, cost, backups, CRDs and operators, a production readiness checklist, and the CKAD/CKA/CKS certification path.
objectives: Explain what a managed control plane gives you and what you still own
Describe EKS building blocks: VPC CNI, node groups vs Fargate vs Karpenter vs Auto Mode, access entries, Pod Identity, AWS Load Balancer Controller
Plan a cluster upgrade respecting version skew, deprecated APIs and PodDisruptionBudgets
Design a namespace and multi-tenancy strategy with quotas, limits, RBAC, policies and network isolation
Name the main cost drivers of a cluster and how to reduce them
Explain what Velero backs up and why databases need their own backups
Write a CRD with schema validation and a minimal reconcile loop, and explain the operator pattern
Choose and prepare for CKAD, CKA or CKS
